# does. .github/workflows/test.yml passes this file to script/setup with

#   script/setup --dev --train --zh --ja --th --torch-cpu
# To update, run that in a fresh checkout and replace the pins below with the

#   .venv/bin/pip freeze --all --exclude-editable | sed 's/+cpu$//'
# torch has no +cpu label here so the pin also matches CUDA builds.
